# Parkdale Breakfast Bar & Grill

> A relaxed Queen Street West bar serving breakfast favourites, comfort food, and drinks. With late weekend hours, a great spot for brunch, a casual meal, or an evening out.

- [Official website](https://joe-zyc.github.io/parkdale-breakfast-bar/)

## Business Information

- Address: 1449 Queen St W, Toronto
- Phone: +1 647-624-7917
- Hours: Monday - Thursday, 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM
- Hours: Friday - Saturday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM
- Hours: Sunday, 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM

## Menu

### Breakfast: Breakfast Menu

- House Breakfast Special: $9.99 — 2 eggs, home fries, toast, and choice of sausage or bacon
- French Toast: $8.99 — 3 pieces of French toast with syrup and butter
- Pancakes: $8.99 — 3 homemade pancakes with syrup and butter

### Lunch: Lunch Menu

- Hamburger: $9.99 — Fresh beef patty served with crispy fries. Add cheese $1.50. Add bacon $1.50
- Chicken Wings: $12.99 — 1 lb of fresh wings with a choice of sauce, served with crispy fries. Sauces: Plain, BBQ, Honey Garlic, or XXX Spicy
- Fish & Chips: $13.99 — Crispy fresh fish served with fries and tartar sauce
- Fried Chicken: $9.99 — 2 pieces of fresh crispy chicken served with fries

### Sides: Sides

- Shrimp Fried Rice: $12.99 — Chinese fried rice served with shrimp
- Poutine: $9.99 — Crispy French fries smothered in cheese and gravy
- Chinese Fried Rice: $8.99 — Stir-fried rice with mixed vegetables and soy sauce
- French Fries: $5.99 — Crispy French fries
- Potato Wedges: $6.99 — Seasoned potato wedges
- Spring Rolls: $5.99 — 5 vegetable spring rolls served with plum sauce

### Drinks: Beer

- Budweiser/Blue/Coors Light/Canadian/Export/Dry: $5.50+TAX
- Moosehead: $6.00+TAX
- Corona/Heineken/Stella Artois/Guinness/Dragon Stout: $7.00+TAX

### Drinks: Spirits

- Shot 1oz: $6.00 — Canadian Club / J.P. Wiser's Deluxe / Captain Morgan Spiced Rum / Bacardí White Rum / Jameson Irish Whiskey
- Shot 1oz: $6.00 — Baileys Irish Cream / Smirnoff Vodka / Crown Royal Whisky / Tequila Añejo / St-Rémy VSOP Brandy
- Mixed Drink 1oz: $7.00

### Drinks: Non-alcoholic

- Hot Tea: $2.50
